name: TypeScript and JavaScript
description: TypeScript and JavaScript diagnostics, completion, hover and navigation in the editor. Ships typescript-language-server and TypeScript inside this extension and runs them with {product}'s own runtime; a project that has its own TypeScript uses that one.

referencesCodeLens.title: Reference counts
referencesCodeLens.description: Show how many references each TypeScript class, interface, type and exported function has, on a line above it

implementationsCodeLens.title: Implementation counts
implementationsCodeLens.description: Show how many implementations each TypeScript interface and abstract class has, on a line above it
